title: [Inspector of Wealth-tax.]
text:
11A. [Inspector of Wealth-tax.]—Omitted by the Direct Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 1987 (4 _of_

1988), _s._ 132 (w.e.f. 1-4-1988). Earlier inserted by Act 46 of 1964, s. 11 (w.e.f. 1-4-1965) _and later_
_substituted by_ _Act 20 of 1967, s. 34 (w.e.f. 1-4-1967)._

11AA. [Commissioner competent to perform any function or functions.]—Omitted by s. 132, ibid.

_w.e.f. 1-4-1988. Earlier section 11AA was inserted by Act 19 of 1970, s. 26_ (w.e.f. 1-4-1970).
